name: @kojo/plugin-sav-parser
description: Emuera binary archive parser. Provides snapshot.source (scan + decode), snapshot.writer (override injection) and archive.reader - the archive read single source (list entries / read one entry's bytes / parse one entry / extract one entry to a legal landing: the persistent workspace root or the save-dialog channel). Zero game knowledge - the byte format is engine-level and shared across games.
